question: Should ClawRouter core own a default-off fusion virtual model plus bundled local OpenAI-compatible provider after the source blockers are repaired?
rationale: The patch adds new user-facing routing/configuration behavior and provider/model-choice semantics, so correctness fixes alone cannot settle whether this belongs in core.

options.title: Sponsor after blockers are fixed
options.body: Keep the PR open, require the readiness/pricing fixes and real behavior proof, then let a maintainer explicitly accept the new core surface.

options.title: Pause for product boundary
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers decide whether ensemble routing and local OpenAI-compatible runtimes should live in core or outside it.

options.title: Decline the core surface
options.body: Close or redirect the work if maintainers decide fusion/local routing should not be bundled into ClawRouter core.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after blockers are fixed
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open, require the readiness/pricing fixes and real behavior proof, then let a maintainer explicitly accept the new core surface.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across the Worker data plane, provider routing, admin console, and this PR's touched surfaces.
